evaluation_methodology: 80/20 train/test stratified split on 1,524 samples combining Berlin SimRa crowdsourced cyclist records with TraCI synthetic surrogate safety kinematic encounters.
accuracy_interpretation: The high test score (1.0 on test partition) reflects the tree ensemble successfully internalizing deterministic physical kinematic thresholds (StVO § 5(4) lateral clearance < 1.2m, emergency braking < -2.5 m/s², TTC < 1.5s). It demonstrates model fidelity to the kinematic surrogate conflict boundaries rather than unconstrained subjective human risk perception.
limitations: SimRa crowdsourced dataset lacks continuous LIDAR/radar lateral distance sensors; lateral clearance in SimRa traces was derived from ultrasonic sensor readings where available or calibrated synthetic proxy.
Model operates on macroscopic kinematic features (clearance, speed, deceleration, TTC); unmodeled environmental factors (road surface condition, weather, lighting) are not captured.
